execution_policy.compiler: Single ordinary-source compile into owned scratch; phase-specific test compile in fresh sequential BEAMs. No shared compiler/build output.
execution_policy.code_paths: Individually hash-verified dependency bytes copied into owned scratch plus this run newly compiled product beams. No shared _build paths or precompiled MixerHosted bytes.
execution_policy.application_boot: No product/dependency application start, no Mix task/project/loadconfig. ExUnit test framework and Mix.State only.
execution_policy.synthetic_state: Each new private BEAM first asserts pointer absent/no registered KeyOwner/no Repo. Test-owned Admission.new ETS process publishes under KeyOwner module key without registration and exits normally to produce a dead reference. Live control keeps that synthetic table alive and verifies no reservation slots. Malformed control publishes one fixed atom. Canonical setup never mutates pointer. Private fixture cleanup only after pointer-preservation assertions.
execution_policy.regression: Retained original exact bytes must produce six setup AssertionErrors and zero Dispatcher.dispatch/3 traced calls for dead pointer. Corrected absent19/dead6 must pass. Live/malformed must produce six setup AssertionErrors and zero dispatch calls. Custom ExUnit formatter checks setup stack frames; call trace delivered before count read.
execution_policy.cleanup: All children sequential start_new_session with PID==PGID; exact owned group only. Each Popen handle is retained for outer-finally cleanup through selector setup and cleanup exceptions; handle clears only after direct child reaped and killpg(pgid,0) confirms absence. Owned scratch created with explicit mkdtemp is removed in outer finally only after every created child has reap/group-absence proof; otherwise retained with failed receipt. No global process inventory. Original input hashes rechecked;55s total includes setup, children, cleanup and verification.
execution_policy.evidence: No evidence overwrite. Exact rendered six bootstraps, argv, source/tool/dependency hashes, bounded stdout, actual PID/PGID, cleanup and aggregate results retained. Root release file must bind exact plan hash.
execution_policy.resources: No network/JWKS/HTTP/DB/container, no real identity owner, no browser/UI/capture/native runtime/phones; no other-project process changes.
